product_family: JSTOR is a digital library platform providing access to academic journals, scholarly articles, primary source documents, images (3M+ from museums/archives), and research tools. Operated by ITHAKA, which also operates Portico and other digital preservation services.

certifications.name: SOC 2
certifications.proof_quote: We adhere to SOC 2 information security standards. SOC 2 is a technical audit that requires organizations to establish strict information security policies and procedures to protect customer data. ITHAKA undergoes annual external audits to ensure ongoing compliance with the physical, administrative, and technical safeguards required under the SOC 2 framework.

certifications.name: GDPR Compliance
certifications.proof_quote: When transferring personally identifying information that is subject to the European Union's General Data Protection Regulations (GDPR), we require a GDPR-approved transfer mechanism to be in place, such as Standard Contractual Clauses.

certifications.name: TRUSTe
certifications.proof_quote: please contact our U.S.-based third-party dispute resolution provider (free of charge) at https://feedback-form.truste.com/watchdog/request

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27001 certification found. ITHAKA holds SOC 2 certification but ISO 27001 status is not documented in publicly available materials.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No evidence of HIPAA compliance documentation. JSTOR does not appear to process health information, making HIPAA compliance out of scope for this vendor.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of PCI DSS certification found. Credit card information is processed via third-party service providers.

privacy.ai_training_note: JSTOR explicitly prohibits users from using Content 'to train large language models or other generative AI technologies' except as specifically permitted. JSTOR reserves the right to use input and output from its own AI features 'to develop and improve JSTOR AI Features solely to the extent consistent with JSTOR's non-profit mission.' JSTOR does not train AI models on customer research data or institutional usage patterns.

security.name: Encryption
security.value: Passwords, physical security measures, managerial measures, and encryption (for credit card information processed through third-party service providers)

security.name: Data Processing
security.value: Third parties process data based on ITHAKA instructions and in compliance with Privacy Policy and appropriate security measures. Standard Contractual Clauses required for GDPR transfers.

security.name: Sub-Processor List
security.value: Available on ITHAKA website; sub-processor list available for transparency

security.name: Annual Audits
security.value: Annual external audits to ensure SOC 2 compliance. SOC 3 Report available (Nov 16, 2023 to Nov 15, 2024).

products.name: JSTOR Academic Research Platform
products.data_scope: User accounts, search history, research preferences, institutional affiliation. Does not automatically train AI on user data.
products.notes: Primary product: multi-disciplinary academic journals, scholarly articles, and primary source content

products.name: JSTOR Text Analysis
products.data_scope: Text submitted for analysis. Users must accept separate terms. Output may be used to improve features.
products.notes: Optional add-on service with separate terms; allows text/data analysis on select JSTOR content

products.name: Artstor Collections
products.data_scope: 3M+ images from museums, archives, scholars. No user-generated content training.
products.notes: Visual materials collection accessible via JSTOR platform

compare.pricing_model: Institutional/library subscriptions (no public per-user pricing available)

flags: No dedicated trust center: security/compliance info embedded in privacy policy rather than a centralized trust/security portal
SOC 2 report (PDF) could not be verified programmatically: report exists at ithaka.org but PDF parsing failed; claims based on privacy policy statement
No ISO 27001 certification: ITHAKA has SOC 2 but does not claim ISO 27001 (common for US orgs; ISO 27001 more common in EU)
Identity verification: JSTOR is operated by ITHAKA (nonprofit). SOC 2 cert belongs to 'ITHAKA HARBORS Inc.' (parent entity); applicable to JSTOR service as JSTOR is part of ITHAKA portfolio
HIPAA is explicitly not applicable: JSTOR is an academic and research content platform, not a health information platform.
AI training posture is clear: JSTOR prohibits customer-driven LLM training on content but reserves right to use its own AI feature interactions for product improvement (non-profit mission)
